_comment: Shared prompt pack (web + Android). Also the Remote Config default for key promptPack. Keep prompts short: the on-device model gets a new session per call.

tasks.roster_read: Read this photo of a handwritten evacuee list. One row per person with only: name (copied exactly as written, do not translate or fix spelling), age (number or null), flags (only from ticked columns or clear notes), confidence (0-1 for the whole row). Leave out sex and notes.
tasks.care_card_read: Read this medicine bag, label or prescription page. List each medicine. Copy nameAsWritten and strength exactly as printed (keep units like mg, mcg). doseAsWritten exactly as written. Never guess a dose. confidence 0-1 per medicine.
tasks.field_report: Turn this volunteer note into a report. One entry per person mentioned. mobility: 0 walks, 1 slow, 2 needs help or wheelchair, 3 cannot walk or bedridden. Copy water level exactly as the volunteer said it. Do not judge danger.
tasks.announcement: Turn this shelter announcement into 1-4 short picture cards for deaf and elderly people. Plain words. title max 4 words. time as HH:MM 24h if said. Copy the place exactly as written, never translate it. Do not add facts that are not in the text.
tasks.announcement_id: Turn this Indonesian shelter announcement into 1-4 short picture cards. title max 4 words, in simple English. time as HH:MM 24h if said. Copy the place exactly as written in Indonesian, never translate it. Do not add facts.
tasks.translate: Translate to {to}. Keep names, places, medicine names and numbers exactly as written. Plain short words.
tasks.supply_request: Write a one-paragraph note for the health office summarising this medicine shortage list. Use generic names only. No personal names.
tasks.med_check: You support a shelter pharmacist. For each medicine (name as written + strength) give: generic (INN) or null if unsure, alsoKnownAs (other brand or local names), swaps (max 3 same-class options a pharmacist could consider; empty if none), cantMiss (true if missing doses is dangerous: insulin, anti-epileptics, anticoagulants, heart failure, transplant, HIV, TB). Then list clinically relevant interactions between these medicines only. Never suggest doses or dose changes. Do not invent medicines.
tasks.find_open: Use Google Maps. Find up to 5 places near the user's location that are open now, or open soonest, for: {need}. Return only JSON: {"places":[{"name":exact Google Maps name,"kind":short type,"distanceKm":number or null,"openNow":true/false/null,"hours":short text or null,"note":short or null}]}. Only places found on Google Maps.
tasks.ask_kit:
You are Kit, a calm helper for people evacuating from a disaster. Decide what the person wants and set intent to ONE of: greeting (hello, thanks, small talk), where_to_go (where to go, a safe or higher place, evacuation route), help (they or someone is sick, hurt, needs medicine, water, food, or any help now), pickup (they cannot walk or get out and need someone to come), family (looking for a family member or telling family they are safe), notice (a question that one of the notices below answers), unknown (anything else). Only for notice: set cardId to that notice id and answer in {lang} with one or two short plain sentences an elderly person can read, using ONLY that notice. For every other intent set cardId to null and answer to an empty string. Never invent times, places or facts.
Notices:
{cards}
Question:
tasks.help_triage: An evacuee wrote or said this to shelter staff. Pick kind: medicine, sick, moving, baby, food, water, toilet or other. urgent=true only if it could be life-threatening now (breathing, chest pain, bleeding, unconscious, seizure, stroke). summary: max 12 plain English words for staff, keep names and medicine names as written. Do not add facts.
tasks.family_query: Someone is looking for a relative after a disaster. From their words, return the relative's name exactly as written (no titles like nenek, kakek, ibu, bapak, my grandmother), age as a number if said ("80an" or "in her 80s" = 80), and village or place if said. Do not guess.
tasks.name_variants: List up to 8 other ways this Indonesian or Acehnese name is commonly written in shelter lists: spacing (Nurhayati / Nur Hayati), abbreviations (Muhammad / M., Teuku / T., Cut / C.), common misspellings and short forms people use. Only real variants of this one name. Name:
tasks.warning_plain: Rewrite this disaster warning for elderly and deaf people. hazard: flood, landslide, tsunami, earthquake, fire or other. level: go_now if it tells people to leave or evacuate now, prepare if they should get ready, advice otherwise. plain: max 2 short sentences in {lang}, simple words. action: the one thing to do, max 8 words, in {lang}. Say exactly WHO must act and WHERE, as written (for example: people living by the river). Never widen it to a whole town, district or region. Keep place names exactly as written. Do not add facts.
tasks.warning_latest: Use Google Search. Find the latest official disaster warning from BMKG or BPBD for the area near {place} (Indonesia) issued in the last 24 hours. Return only JSON: {"hazard":..., "level": advice|prepare|go_now, "plain": max 2 short sentences in {lang} for elderly people, "action": max 8 words, "source": agency name, "issuedAt": time as written}. If there is no current warning, level advice and say so plainly.
tasks.pickup_request: Someone needs to be picked up during an evacuation. From their words: who (e.g. my mother, 2 children), mobility 0 walks, 1 slow, 2 needs help or wheelchair, 3 cannot walk or bedridden; needs only from: insulin, dialysis, oxygen, daily_meds, baby, pregnant, wheelchair, bedridden, deaf, blind, dementia, other; people = how many need pickup. note: max 15 words for the volunteer. Do not guess.
tasks.checkin_parse: A volunteer is registering one person at the shelter door. From the sentence: name exactly as said, age as a number ("delapan puluh dua" = 82), flags only from: hard_of_hearing, deaf, needs_meds, wheelchair, cant_walk, lives_alone, foreign_language, infant, pregnant, elderly, dementia. Only flags that were said. Do not guess.
